boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Salve Regina University
boards.description: Ten under-21-safe food destinations with directly documented evening availability on campus and around Newport.

cards.title: The Nest
cards.subtitle: Gerety Hall, Salve Regina University
cards.notes: Head to Gerety Hall when you need food later in the evening; check the dining site before leaving because campus schedules can change during breaks.
cards.short_summary: An on-campus option with a documented late-night meal-exchange window.
cards.evidence_claim: Salve Regina Dining says The Nest serves food daily from 11 a.m. to 11:30 p.m. and offers late-night meal exchange from 8:30 to 11:30 p.m.
cards.access_notes: Documented daily food service runs until 11:30 p.m.; the page also notes summer-break status, so confirm service for the date you visit.

cards.title: McKillop Library Café
cards.subtitle: McKillop Library, Salve Regina University
cards.notes: Use the café for a study-break meal exchange Monday through Thursday, then verify the academic-calendar status before relying on it during a break.
cards.short_summary: A campus library café whose listed meal exchange extends to 11:30 p.m. on weekdays.
cards.evidence_claim: Salve Regina Dining lists McKillop Library Café meal-exchange service Monday through Thursday from 11 a.m. to 11:30 p.m.
cards.source_title: McKillop Library Café | Salve Regina University
cards.access_notes: Meal exchange is listed until 11:30 p.m. Monday–Thursday; the page marks the café closed during summer break.

cards.title: Nikolas Pizza
cards.subtitle: 38 Memorial Blvd. W., Newport
cards.notes: Plan a Friday or Saturday pickup if you need the latest listed window; use the restaurant’s online ordering or call ahead to confirm the kitchen is still taking orders.
cards.short_summary: A Newport pizza stop with midnight hours on Friday and Saturday.
cards.evidence_claim: Nikolas Pizza lists revised Friday and Saturday hours of 11 a.m. to 12 a.m. at 38 Memorial Blvd. W. in Newport.
cards.access_notes: Friday and Saturday are listed until midnight; Sunday through Thursday hours end earlier.

cards.title: Port Pizza
cards.subtitle: 659 W. Main Rd., Middletown
cards.notes: For a very late pickup, confirm the day’s hours before traveling to Middletown and place an order through the restaurant’s own ordering link when available.
cards.short_summary: A Middletown pizza destination with hours extending past midnight on most listed days.
cards.evidence_claim: Port Pizza lists hours until 2:30 a.m. Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday through Sunday, and until midnight Wednesday.
cards.access_notes: Listed closing is 2:30 a.m. most days and midnight Wednesday; verify on the restaurant site before making the trip.

cards.title: J.T. Commons
cards.subtitle: 1037 Aquidneck Ave., Middletown
cards.notes: Use the posted late-night menu after 8 p.m. and check the day before going, especially if you are relying on Friday or Saturday’s later closing time.
cards.short_summary: A Middletown restaurant with a specifically documented late-night menu.
cards.evidence_claim: J.T. Commons advertises a late-night menu nightly after 8 p.m. and lists Friday–Saturday hours until 11 p.m.
cards.source_title: J.T. Commons | Pizza & Casual Dining | Middletown, RI
cards.access_notes: The official page lists food service until 10 p.m. Sunday–Thursday and 11 p.m. Friday–Saturday, with a late-night menu after 8 p.m.

cards.title: Aquidneck Pizzeria
cards.subtitle: 27 Aquidneck Ave., Middletown
cards.notes: Choose this stop for a straightforward evening pizza order; check opening status directly before you leave, particularly around holidays or severe weather.
cards.short_summary: A Middletown pizzeria listing consistent daily hours through 10 p.m.
cards.evidence_claim: Aquidneck Pizzeria lists daily opening hours from 7 a.m. to 10 p.m. at 27 Aquidneck Ave. in Middletown.
cards.access_notes: The official site lists 10 p.m. closing every day.

cards.title: The Mooring Seafood Kitchen & Bar
cards.subtitle: 1 Sayers Wharf, Newport
cards.notes: Reserve or call ahead for an evening table near the harbor, and use the restaurant’s official hours as the check before walking over from downtown.
cards.short_summary: A Sayers Wharf restaurant listing daily service until 10 p.m.
cards.evidence_claim: The Mooring lists daily hours of operation from 11:30 a.m. to 10 p.m. at 1 Sayers Wharf in Newport.
cards.source_title: The Mooring Seafood Kitchen & Bar Restaurant | Newport, RI
cards.access_notes: Officially listed as open daily until 10 p.m.; check reservations and same-day availability before visiting.

cards.title: Smoke House
cards.subtitle: 31 Scotts Wharf, Newport
cards.notes: Use the listed 10 p.m. close for an evening food stop on the waterfront; confirm the date’s service and seating availability through the restaurant before heading over.
cards.short_summary: A Scotts Wharf restaurant with daily food-service hours ending at 10 p.m.
cards.evidence_claim: Smoke House lists hours of 11:30 a.m. to 10 p.m. Monday–Friday and 11 a.m. to 10 p.m. Saturday–Sunday.
cards.access_notes: The restaurant’s official page lists a 10 p.m. close every day.

cards.title: La Vecina Taqueria
cards.subtitle: 24 Washington Square, Newport
cards.notes: For an evening meal near Washington Square, check the restaurant group’s current listing before going and plan around the daily 10 p.m. closing time.
cards.short_summary: A Washington Square taqueria with dinner listed through 10 p.m. every day.
cards.evidence_claim: Newport Restaurant Group lists La Vecina Taqueria open Monday–Saturday until 10 p.m. and Sunday dinner until 10 p.m.
cards.source_title: Newport Restaurant Group | Contact and Restaurant Hours
cards.access_notes: The official group page lists closing at 10 p.m. daily, with Sunday dinner beginning at 2 p.m.

cards.title: Pescadou
cards.subtitle: Hotel Viking, 1 Bellevue Ave., Newport
cards.notes: Plan this as a Friday or Saturday dinner option and make a reservation when possible; verify the hotel’s dining page for any seasonal or special-event changes.
cards.short_summary: A Hotel Viking restaurant with dinner listed until 10 p.m. on Friday and Saturday.
cards.evidence_claim: Hotel Viking lists Pescadou dinner from 5 to 10 p.m. Friday and Saturday, and identifies the hotel at One Bellevue Ave. in Newport.
cards.source_title: Dining at Hotel Viking | Newport, RI Restaurants
cards.access_notes: Friday and Saturday dinner is listed from 5 to 10 p.m.; Sunday–Thursday dinner ends at 9 p.m.
